title: Methodologies Explain Potential Differences in UCR Data
v2_primary_role: classify official surfaces before use
v2_not_for: numeric inputs
practical_notes: Explicitly says publication tables can differ from CDE/explorer/master-style data because publication tables undergo internal quality review while open-data style files keep all reported data in file.

title: Documents & Downloads
v2_primary_role: annual source selection and dataset discovery
v2_not_for: direct numeric ingestion without selecting a specific downloadable family
practical_notes: This is the authoritative front door for current FBI download families and exposes release/update timing.

title: Crime in the United States Annual Reports
geography_scope: national; state; county; city; university; agency
v2_primary_role: canonical FBI publication-style annual controls and published agency tables
v2_not_for: raw reported-universe engineering or agency roster policy
practical_notes: Use for CIUS/RCN-style annual totals and tables 8-11 style published agency counts. Published agency tables are limited to agencies with 12 months of complete offense data.

title: UCR Publications
v2_primary_role: historical continuity for publication-style lanes
v2_not_for: current-year dynamic monitoring or raw/open-data extraction
practical_notes: Use together with CDE annual report bundles to keep a single publication-lane methodology across the FBI site migration.

title: Crime Explorer Pages
v2_primary_role: monitoring, anomaly triage, and quick comparisons
v2_not_for: canonical annual controls or publication-table replication
practical_notes: Dynamic and timestamped. Violent/property views mix SRS and summarized NIBRS for trend purposes. Values can move as updates arrive.

title: Data Discovery Tool
v2_primary_role: ORI/name validation and targeted lookups
v2_not_for: official annual control totals or raw incident replacement
practical_notes: Useful for spot checks and roster discovery. Query methodology references hierarchy-rule style violent/property handling rather than raw incident counting.

title: Crime Data API
v2_primary_role: API endpoint discovery and official machine-access framing
v2_not_for: blind assumption that every endpoint is annual-control ready
practical_notes: Treat API lanes separately by payload purpose: roster, dynamic query, or downloadable/master-like support.

title: Agency Roster by State Abbreviation API
geography_scope: national by state to county grouping
v2_primary_role: ORI roster validation and NIBRS transition auditing
v2_not_for: crime totals or blind year-specific source policy
practical_notes: The raw is_nibrs flag is current participation status; use nibrs_start_date to derive effective-year NIBRS status.

title: Crime Incident-Based Data by State
v2_primary_role: raw incident/offense/victim/property engineering and ORI-level NIBRS support
v2_not_for: publication-style controls across the SRS era
practical_notes: Use when the lane requires raw incident detail. Do not expect exact agreement with CIUS or Explorer violent/property summaries.

title: Master File Downloads (Annual)
v2_primary_role: historical raw continuity and full in-file reported universe
v2_not_for: publication-table replication without transformation
practical_notes: Master files are fixed-length ASCII/WinZip and require programming extraction. They follow the all-reported-data-in-file logic.

title: Master File Downloads (Year-to-Date)
v2_primary_role: in-year monitoring only
v2_not_for: stable annual V2 inputs
practical_notes: Explicitly monthly/provisional. Useful only for monitoring before annual close.

title: Summary Reporting System (SRS) Estimated Crimes Dataset
v2_primary_role: historical state/national continuity with the legacy FBI estimate series
v2_not_for: agency-level reported-count reconciliation or BJS-estimate substitution
practical_notes: A legacy SRS-based estimate family. Do not silently splice with BJS NIBRS estimates.

title: NIBRS Estimation Tables
geography_scope: national and selected subnational estimate geographies
v2_primary_role: official static-download entry point for the newer NIBRS estimate family
v2_not_for: legacy CIUS estimate continuity or raw agency counts
practical_notes: CDE states these methods were developed with BJS. Treat as the NIBRS-estimate family, not as a continuation of the old SRS estimate lane.

title: Uniform Crime Reporting Program Participation Data
v2_primary_role: coverage denominators and transition context
v2_not_for: crime totals or ORI-level roster validation
practical_notes: Counts agencies reporting in any format and covered population. Context only.

title: NIBRS Estimation Program
v2_primary_role: official explanation of why NIBRS estimation exists and how it differs from prior practice
v2_not_for: raw reported-count inputs
practical_notes: Use to understand the new estimate family and why 2021+ is not just a deterministic recode of pre-2021 mixed reporting.

title: NIBRS National Estimates API
geography_scope: national and selected subnational estimate domains
v2_primary_role: machine-readable BJS estimate pulls
v2_not_for: city/agency raw counts or legacy SRS estimate continuity
practical_notes: Current endpoints can revise prior years; archive endpoints preserve originally published values.

title: Crime Known to Law Enforcement, 2024
v2_primary_role: human-readable official benchmark for the NIBRS estimate family
v2_not_for: raw reported totals or city incident reconciliation
practical_notes: Use for published estimate interpretation, suppression, RMSE, and coverage notes.

title: Estimation Procedures for Crimes in the United States Based on NIBRS Data
v2_primary_role: methodology doctrine for 2021+ NIBRS estimates
v2_not_for: direct numeric input
practical_notes: Explains how NIBRS-only estimation differs from the previous process and why weighting and imputation are needed.

title: NIBRS Estimates Codebook and Supplementary Documentation
v2_primary_role: field-level interpretation of estimate files and reliability variables
v2_not_for: standalone crime inputs
practical_notes: Critical for suppression, RMSE, estimate domains, and archive/current endpoint interpretation.

title: Law Enforcement Agency Reported Crime Analysis Tool (LEARCAT)
v2_primary_role: secondary reconciliation and exploratory analytics
v2_not_for: authoritative CDE/FBI count matching or universal-rate surface
practical_notes: LEARCAT uses NIBRS but has its own offense groupings and full-reporter-state coverage rules.

title: LEARCAT Methodology
v2_primary_role: guardrails for LEARCAT use
v2_not_for: direct numeric inputs
practical_notes: States some offense definitions differ from CDE and that rates are limited to full-reporter states.

title: Uniform Crime Reporting System (UCR) & National Incident Based Reporting System (NIBRS)
v2_primary_role: quick taxonomy and context on UCR components, transition, and archival links
v2_not_for: authoritative numeric input selection
practical_notes: Useful because it cleanly distinguishes summary, county, incident, and archival/OpenICPSR derivative files, but it is not itself an authoritative data surface.

title: Uniform Crime Reporting Program Data Series
v2_primary_role: archival taxonomy of UCR components and legacy files
v2_not_for: current official source selection or numeric authority
practical_notes: Useful for understanding the archived component structure and county/statewide allocation conventions in historical ICPSR releases.
